name: eval2 sample pack (Gate E): Zaina with her piano, the piano close up, the bath and the tub over the stool with its empty place, the passport. Level file levels/LEVEL-eval2.md, Gates A to D signed 25 Oct 2026.
notes: Judged in the level on the tablet, never as loose files. A failed sample goes back to its prompt, not to the batch.
Cut-outs keyed on white with tools/keywhite.py; the stool lifted with tools/lift.py against the stoolgone edit; close-ups saved at 1920x1080 JPEG 88.

cases.prompt:
Style: a polished, finished illustration drawn for a game, not a picture book for toddlers; clean dark-ink outlines on everything, a shadow side on every object and soft cast shadows from one light source, so things sit solidly on their surfaces; smooth colour with gentle shading, a faint paper-grain texture and a gentle vignette at the edges. Bright and clear, not hazy or dark. Attached picture 1 is the character: draw exactly this girl, the same face, hair, colouring and clothes. Attached picture 2 is a crop from the room she sits in: copy only its style, hand and palette. Palette of the room: warm cream walls, white painted wood, honey wood floor, cheerful sticker colours, soft rainy-afternoon light. Draw it alone on a pure flat white background: no surface, no shadow on the ground, no frame, no border, no text, nothing else in the picture. The object fills most of the frame. No words, letters, numbers or symbols anywhere in the picture.

The character: the girl from picture 1, aged four, sitting cross-legged facing us, a small pink toy piano resting on her knees, both hands on its keys, smiling down at it. Her whole body shows, sitting, as if on a bed (the bed itself is not drawn). The toy piano has eight plain white keys in a row and a thin slot along its top.
cases.note: asset 22, Zaina's cut-out on the lower bunk (k2)
